title: Score & Bake
tagline: Slash a sourdough loaf, then watch the oven open your cuts.
how_to: Drag across the dough to score it, pick a doneness, then tap Bake. No sound.
description: You are the baker with the blade. Draw cuts across a floured sourdough boule, choose how dark to bake it, and watch the oven spring split your slashes into crumb-white openings with raised golden ears. Different patterns get different verdicts, and an unscored loaf blows out its side.
spark: Sourdough taken literally: the craft of scoring a loaf before it goes in the oven.
proud_of: The ear lifts on the side the blade travelled, so your drag direction shapes the bloom.
